issues.description: Function init_world: the problem statement requires implementing init_world(width, height) (two parameters). The template repository (helloWorld.asm) does not provide a stub for init_world. The solution repository (helloWorld.asm, lines 6-8) defines an init_world symbol but its implementation only reads a single argument (mov eax, [esp+4]; comment: 'Only handles width'), i.e. it effectively accepts one parameter rather than the two named in the problem statement. This discrepancy between the documented required signature and the provided solution implementation can confuse students about the expected parameter count and calling convention (where to read width vs. height) and may lead to incorrect student implementations or unnecessary investigation.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the expectation consistent across artifacts. Either (A) update the template to include a clear stub for init_world(width, height) and document the calling convention (e.g. cdecl stack layout: width at [esp+4], height at [esp+8]), and update the solution implementation to read both parameters (e.g. mov eax, [esp+4]; mov ecx, [esp+8]) or otherwise handle both width and height; or (B) if only width should be required, update the problem statement to specify init_world(width) (one parameter) and document that explicitly. Prefer adding a two-parameter stub in the template and adjusting the solution to handle both parameters so the statement, template, and solution agree.
